title: Cross-ITP Concept Concordance Knowledge Base
description: Cross-ITP Proof-Mechanism Concordance mapping Lean 4, Coq/Rocq (MathComp/SSReflect), Isabelle/HOL (Isar), HOL Light, Agda, and Metamath tactics, structural idioms, and pitfall bridges across 20 canonical proof mechanisms.

mechanisms.description: Elimination of inductive datatypes and inductive predicates via pattern matching, case exhaustion, and structural induction principles.

lean4.syntax_pattern: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc
lean4.semantics: Dependent elimination constructing an inductive motive with automated unification of index equations.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use induction for recursive types, rcases for structured destruction with tuple unpacking, and nomatch for empty types.
pitfalls: Variable capture during induction hypothesis instantiation
Accidental generalization of non-variable terms
Loss of index equality constraints if using naive cases instead of rcases

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: elim: n => [| n' ih] //=
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Elimination principle invocation using recursor generated by Inductive definition; ssreflect views connect reflection predicates directly to case analysis.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Prefer case: and elim: with ssreflect intro-patterns and trailing simplifiers //=.
pitfalls: Forgetting to generalize dependent premises prior to induction
Wildcard naming leading to fragile script breakages

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: proof (induct n arbitrary: m rule: nat.induct)
isabelle_hol.semantics: Higher-order resolution against the datatype induction theorem with universal quantification over arbitrary variables.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Structured Isar calculation with case (Suc n) keeping hypothesis names explicit.
pitfalls: Failure to declare arbitrary variables causing unprovable induction hypotheses
Rule selection ambiguity when inductive predicate shadows datatype

hol_light.semantics: Direct tactical application of the Peano induction theorem or theorem returned by new_inductive_definition.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Pair INDUCT_TAC with tactical composition THENL branching on base and step goals.
pitfalls: Loss of antecedent context if not popped and generalized before induction

agda.syntax_pattern: thm zero = h0 ; thm (suc n) = hsucc n (thm n)
agda.semantics: Dependent clausal pattern matching and structural recursion verified by Agda's termination checker.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Write explicit clausal equations over constructors (`zero`, `suc n`), using `with` for intermediate scrutiny and `()` for empty patterns.
pitfalls: Dot patterns or `with`-abstractions failing when indices depend on non-variable terms
Non-structural recursion rejected without an explicit `WellFounded` accessibility witness

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Mathematical induction & case elimination: nnind, uzind, jaoi $)
metamath.semantics: Explicit induction theorems (`nnind` on `N`, `uzind` on `Z>=M`, `sfind` on finite sets) paired with explicit substitution lemmas (`fveq`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Construct explicit substitution lemmas for `P(0)`, `P(k)`, `P(k+1)`, and `P(n)` before applying `nnind` or `uzind`.
pitfalls: All 4 substitution hypotheses must be proven explicitly before invoking `nnind` or `uzind`
Forgetting disjoint-variable `$d` constraints on the induction variable

translation_rules.notes: Direct correspondence between Lean 4 rcases patterns and MathComp intro-patterns.
Isabelle arbitrary corresponds to Lean 4 generalizing clause.
Peano induction step mapping.

translation_rules.source_construct: thm zero = h0 ; thm (suc n) = hsucc n (thm n)
translation_rules.target_construct: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n ih => hsucc n ih
translation_rules.notes: Agda clausal recursion maps directly to Lean 4 induction or fun_induction.

translation_rules.source_construct: nnind / uzind with 4 explicit substitution lemmas
translation_rules.notes: Lean 4 higher-order unification discharges the 4 Metamath substitution hypotheses automatically.

mechanisms.description: Equivalence between constructive boolean propositions (decidable in finite computational steps) and informative proofs in Prop.

lean4.syntax_pattern: by decide
lean4.semantics: Kernel evaluation of instances of Decidable p reducing decide p = true to definitional equality.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use by decide for bounded finite combinatorial checks; use omega for Presburger integer arithmetic.
pitfalls: Expensive kernel reduction triggering maximum heartbeat limits
Typeclass resolution failure if Decidable instance is missing or noncomputable

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: apply/idP: H
coq_mathcomp.semantics: MathComp inductive predicate reflect (P : Prop) : bool -> Type with canonical ssreflect views.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Replace Prop-valued connective reasoning with decidable bool predicates and ssreflect views apply/idP.
pitfalls: Accidental mixing of Prop \/ and bool || causing reflection failure
Stack overflow in vm_compute if terms lack normal forms

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: by (simp add: eval)
isabelle_hol.semantics: Code generator translation to Poly/ML or target language, compiled and executed out-of-band via oracle.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Define executable functions via fun and discharge finite instances via eval.
pitfalls: Reliance on code generation oracle introduces trust boundary beyond Pure logic kernel

hol_light.semantics: Conversion functions term -> thm producing equational theorems |- t = t' purely through kernel primitive inference steps.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Chain conversions CBV_CONV or custom equational simplifiers through CONV_TAC.
pitfalls: Slow execution on large numeric certificates compared to compiled VM evaluation

agda.syntax_pattern: P? x : Dec (P x) | from-yes (P? x)
agda.semantics: `Relation.Nullary.Decidable` (`Dec P` wrapping `does : Bool` and `proof : Reflects P does`) enabling proof by computation (`from-yes`).
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Use `from-yes (m <=? n)` for closed decidable goals and `with P? x` to split on `(yes p)` vs `(no ~p)`.
pitfalls: Computing with unary `Nat` decision procedures blows up on large numerals unless `Builtin.Nat` is used

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Truth value & decimal computation theorems: tru, decadd, decmul $)
metamath.semantics: Propositional truth constant `T.` (`df-tru`) and explicit decimal arithmetic / Pratt certificate theorems (`decadd`, `decmul`, `prmo`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Collapse multi-step decimal evaluation (`decadd`, `decmul`) or finite truth-table checks into `decide` or `norm_num` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Metamath has no kernel reduction; every computational step is an explicit theorem application

translation_rules.notes: Connects MathComp idP view to Lean 4 decide boolean reflection lemma.
Computational reflection dispatch.
Agda Dec reflection maps to Lean 4 Decidable typeclass and decide tactic.
Collapse explicit Metamath arithmetic calculation chains into decide or norm_num.

mechanisms.description: Targeted and confluent replacement of subterms along directed equational theorems and confluence simplification.

lean4.syntax_pattern: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]
lean4.semantics: Leibniz substitution via Eq.rec for rw; confluent term rewriting using congruence lemmas and contextual discrimination trees for simp.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use rw for explicit targeted steps; use simp only [...] in maintainable production code to avoid unconstrained simplifier loops.
pitfalls: Non-terminating simplifier loops when non-decreasing lemmas are added to simp
Hidden typeclass synthesis failures during rewrite

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: rewrite /def -[t]h1 !lem
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Setoid or Leibniz rewriting with pattern occurrence selection and automatic side-condition discharging.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: MathComp ssreflect rewrite with lock/unlock flags, occurrence indicators {1 3}, and inline simplification //.
pitfalls: Occurrence matching mismatch when implicit arguments differ
Setoid rewrite failure when Proper instances are missing

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: apply (simp add: my_lemma del: bad_lemma)
isabelle_hol.semantics: Higher-order conditional term rewriting system with confluent ordered rewriting for AC-operators.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Use simp add: with controlled declarations; use subst with positional coordinates for exact non-confluent substitutions.
pitfalls: Simp loops caused by mutual equational cycles
Looped simplification of conditional rewrite rules whose premises diverge

hol_light.semantics: Repeated top-down rewrite conversion using an equational database until a normal form is reached.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Use PURE_REWRITE_TAC when standard rewrites (basic_rewrites) interfere with goal structure.
pitfalls: Unbounded loop in REWRITE_TAC on reflexivity permutations like commutativity without AC handling

agda.syntax_pattern: prf lhs | rewrite eq1 | rewrite eq2 = refl
agda.semantics: `rewrite eq` desugars into a `with`-abstraction over the LHS of `eq` followed by matching on `refl`.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Prefer explicit `cong` / `subst` or `≡-Reasoning` chains over deeply nested `rewrite` clauses.
pitfalls: `rewrite` fails with ill-typed `with`-abstraction when the goal's type depends on the rewritten subterm in a non-generalizable way

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Congruence & transitivity rewriting: eqtri, 3eqtr4i, fveq2i $)
metamath.semantics: Explicit equality transitivity (`eqtri`, `3eqtr4i`) and explicit functorial congruence lemmas (`fveq1i`, `fveq2i`, `oveq12i`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Replace Metamath congruence chains (`fveq2i`, `oveq12i`, `3eqtr4i`) with `rw [...]` or `simp only [...]` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Every subterm position requires its own congruence theorem (`oveq1i` vs `oveq2i`) in Metamath

translation_rules.notes: Direct equivalence between Isabelle simp only and Lean 4 simp only.
MathComp head unfolding maps to Lean 4 dsimp/unfold.
Direct mapping from Agda rewrite clauses to Lean 4 rw list.
Lean 4 rw/simp synthesizes congruence proofs automatically.

mechanisms.description: Resolution of algebraic and categorical structures, canonical projections, and inheritance hierarchies.

lean4.syntax_pattern: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...
lean4.semantics: Tableau-based backward search with cached instances, out-parameters, and default field synthesis.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Extend flatter semi-bundled structures; avoid diamonds with inconsistent data fields; use outParam carefully.
pitfalls: Exponential synthesis time from looping or depth-unbounded instance declarations
Diamond conflicts where two paths synthesize distinct data fields

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: Structure group := Pack { sort : Type; class : class_of sort }
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Packed classes (MathComp): explicit record telescopes of mixins with Canonical Structure inference via unification hints.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Bundle operations and laws into mixins, then seal the hierarchy behind a single canonical constructor.
pitfalls: Inscrutable unification failures when canonical projections do not trigger
Boilerplate overhead when extending deep inheritance hierarchies

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: class group = monoid + inverse + assumes ...
isabelle_hol.semantics: Order-sorted algebra with single-parameter axiomatic type classes and multi-parameter locales with interpretation morphisms.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Combine axiomatic type classes for arithmetic with locales for advanced abstract algebra (e.g. rings, modules).
pitfalls: Inability of Isabelle type classes to take multiple type parameters directly without locales
Hidden locale interpretation obligations

hol_light.semantics: Unbundled Simple Type Theory: groups and rings are explicit tuples or predicates over sets; no native typeclass engine.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Pass structure dictionaries explicitly or bundle carrier sets with operation records.
pitfalls: Heavy manual plumbing of structure dictionaries across every lemma
No automated resolution of default operators

agda.syntax_pattern: record IsGroup (G : Set) : Set where ... | {{_ : IsGroup G}}
agda.semantics: Explicit bundle/unbundled record hierarchies (`Algebra.Bundles`, `Algebra.Structures`) in `agda-stdlib` with optional `{{...}}` instance search.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `agda-stdlib` bundled records (`Group c l`, `Ring c l`) to Lean 4 `[Group G]` / `[Ring R]` typeclass binders.
pitfalls: Opening multiple algebraic records simultaneously in Agda causes field name shadowing unless renamed

metamath.syntax_pattern: G e. Grp , B = ( Base ` G ) , .+ = ( +g ` G )
metamath.semantics: Extensible structure tuples encoded as functions on numeric slot indices (`Base`, `+g`, `.r`, `0g`) with class membership `G e. Grp`.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Convert `G e. Grp` and slot projections `(Base ` G)`, `(+g ` G)` into `(G : Type*) [Group G]` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Metamath structure operations are untyped total class functions outside `(Base ` G)`

translation_rules.notes: Packed class mixins unpack into Lean 4 instance fields.
Isabelle instantiation block maps directly to Lean 4 instance declaration.
Agda algebraic bundles map to Lean 4 typeclass binders.

translation_rules.source_construct: G e. Grp , B = ( Base ` G ) , .+ = ( +g ` G )
translation_rules.notes: Eliminates explicit slot projections in favor of typeclass synthesis.

mechanisms.description: Algorithmic proof search combining propositional logic, first-order resolution, tableaux, and domain-specific decision procedures.

lean4.syntax_pattern: aesop (add safe ...) or omega
lean4.semantics: Whitebox tree search over rule sets with custom normalization, safe/unsafe rule splits, and Cooper LIA decision.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Configure domain-specific aesop rule sets; discharge linear integer constraints with omega and ring equalities with ring.
pitfalls: Aesop explosion on branching unsafe rules
Non-reproducible proof timings if search limits drift

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: eauto with mydb or lia
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Depth-first iterative deepening proof search with unification; Fourier-Motzkin and Presburger procedures in lia.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Group auxiliary lemmas into hint databases (Hint Resolve, Hint Rewrite) and invoke auto with ...
pitfalls: eauto getting stuck in infinite unification depth without progress
Slow compilation of heavy firstorder invocations

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: by (metis add.commute mult.assoc) or by blast
isabelle_hol.semantics: Generic tableaux reasoning (blast), ordered resolution provers (metis), and external ATP/SMT reconstruction (sledgehammer).
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Use sledgehammer interactively to discover minimal lemma sets, then reconstruct with deterministic metis.
pitfalls: Metis timeouts on complex higher-order goals
Sledgehammer finding proofs that fail local reconstruction

hol_light.syntax_pattern: MESON [lem1; lem2] `!x. P x ==> Q x`
hol_light.semantics: Model elimination (MESON), resolution (METIS), and exact linear arithmetic decision procedures producing kernel certificates.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Pass explicit lemma lists into MESON_TAC for first-order logic subgoals.
pitfalls: Exponential search blowup if irrelevant lemmas are provided in search list

agda.syntax_pattern: {! -m !} | solve 2 (\ x y -> lhs := rhs) refl
agda.semantics: Edit-time proof-term synthesis via Mimer/Agsy and reflective algebraic solvers (`Data.Nat.Solver`, `Algebra.Solver.Ring`).
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Replace reflective `+-*-Solver.solve` calls with `ring` / `omega` and Mimer-generated term trees with `aesop` / `grind` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Agda has no runtime tactic engine; all search happens at edit time or via explicit reflection

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Hilbert propositional & first-order chains: ax-1..3, mp, syl, mpd $)
metamath.semantics: Explicit Hilbert-style deduction chains synthesized by `mmj2` unification search.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Collapse 10-100 step Hilbert propositional/syllogism subproofs in `set.mm` into `tauto`, `aesop`, `omega`, or `ring` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Never port raw `syl`/`mpd`/`com12` plumbing lemmas 1-to-1 into Lean 4

translation_rules.notes: Isabelle blast tableaux search maps to Lean 4 aesop rule search.
Coq lia and Lean 4 omega are Presburger LIA solvers.
Reflective semiring/ring solver maps to Lean 4 ring/omega.
Collapses explicit Hilbert deduction steps.

mechanisms.description: Step-by-step equational and inequality reasoning chaining transitivity theorems in readable mathematical prose.

lean4.syntax_pattern: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3
lean4.semantics: Transitivity typeclass synthesis Trans r1 r2 r3 combining intermediate relation witnesses.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use calc for multi-step analytic inequalities; Lean 4 automatically fills the omitted left-hand side.
pitfalls: Transitivity instance missing for custom relations
Mismatched relations (e.g. strict vs non-strict order transitivity)

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: have ->: a = b by ...; have ->: b = c by ...; reflexivity.
coq_mathcomp.semantics: RelationClasses transitivity instances discharged through tactic engine or explicit lemma application.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: MathComp users frequently structure calculation proofs via consecutive rewrite steps rather than explicit calc environments.
pitfalls: Unification failures on uninstantiated intermediate variables in transitivity

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: have "a = b" proof ... also have "... <= c" proof ... finally show "a <= c" .
isabelle_hol.semantics: Isar calculation rules registered via [trans] attribute, accumulating intermediate terms in the calculation register.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Chain also have statements culminating in finally show; use ellipsis ... for the antecedent term.
pitfalls: Order of terms reversed, breaking transitivity rule matching
Forgetting the final . or by assumption

hol_light.syntax_pattern: MATCH_MP_TAC REAL_LE_TRANS THEN EXISTS_TAC `b:real` THEN CONJ_TAC
hol_light.semantics: Explicit forward or backward application of transitivity theorems (LE_TRANS, EQ_TRANS).
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Compose conversions or forward transitivity rules with MATCH_MP.
pitfalls: Manual introduction and maintenance of intermediate terms

agda.syntax_pattern: begin a ≡⟨ h1 ⟩ b ≤⟨ h2 ⟩ c ∎
agda.semantics: Mixfix preorder and equational reasoning combinators from `Relation.Binary.Reasoning.Preorder`.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `begin a ≡⟨ h1 ⟩ b ≤⟨ h2 ⟩ c ∎` directly to a Lean 4 `calc` block.
pitfalls: Mixing `≡⟨_⟩_` and `≤⟨_⟩_` requires opening the preorder reasoning module rather than propositional equality reasoning

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Transitive calculation chain: 3eqtri, eqletr, lelttr $)
metamath.semantics: N-ary transitive chain theorems (`3eqtri`, `3eqtr4i`, `eqletr`, `lelttr`, `ltletr`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Unpack nested `3eqtri` / `eqletr` / `lelttr` applications into a linear `calc` block in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Keep track of strict (`<`, `ltletr`) vs weak (`<=`, `letr`) steps when flattening tree-structured transitivity proofs

translation_rules.source_construct: have "a = b" ... also have "... <= c" ... finally show "a <= c"
translation_rules.target_construct: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2
translation_rules.notes: Isar also/finally calculation chain maps 1:1 to Lean 4 calc environment.

translation_rules.source_construct: begin a ≡⟨ h1 ⟩ b ≤⟨ h2 ⟩ c ∎
translation_rules.target_construct: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2
translation_rules.notes: 1-to-1 structural isomorphism between Agda ≡-Reasoning and Lean 4 calc.
Linearizes tree-structured Metamath transitivity chains.

mechanisms.description: Formation of quotient structures by equivalence relations, sound lifting of operations, and congruence preservation.

lean4.syntax_pattern: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp
lean4.semantics: Primitive kernel quotient types (Quot) satisfying computational reduction and propositional extensionality.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Define a Setoid instance, then construct types via Quotient s and lift maps via Quotient.lift.
pitfalls: Accidental non-computability if lifting functions to types outside Prop without well-definedness proof
Forgetting that Quot is not a syntactic datatype

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: setoid_rewrite h or Instance: Proper (equiv ==> equiv) f.
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Setoid framework based on morphism relation classes (Proper); quotients formed via equivalence classes or axiom of extensionality.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Register congruence relations with Add Parametric Relation and declare Proper instances for all operators.
pitfalls: Setoid rewriting fails if a single subterm lacks a Proper instance
Heavy term bloat when quotients are modeled as sets of equivalence classes

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: quotient_type 'a quottype = "'a rawtype" / "rel"
isabelle_hol.semantics: Lifting and Transfer package automating the correspondence between raw representation types and quotiented abstract types.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Declare the quotient with quotient_type, define operations with quotient_definition, and transfer proofs with transfer.
pitfalls: Equivalence relation reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity proof obligations must be discharged before type definition

hol_light.semantics: Equivalence classes modeled as subsets of the carrier type with canonical representative selection.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Use the HOL Light quotient library to define canonical representatives and lift equational theorems.
pitfalls: Heavy manual management of equivalence class sets without kernel quotient support

agda.syntax_pattern: record Setoid c l : Set (suc (c ⊔ l)) | data _/_ (A : Type) (R : A -> A -> Type)
agda.semantics: Explicit Bishop `Setoid` records in standard Agda (`--without-K`) or Higher Inductive Type quotients `A / R` in Cubical Agda (`--cubical`).
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Map Agda `Setoid` carriers + `≈` to Lean 4 `Setoid α` and `Quotient s`, or Cubical `elimProp`/`rec` to `Quotient.ind`/`Quotient.lift`.
pitfalls: Standard Agda lacks kernel quotients; every function on a Setoid carries an explicit `cong` field

metamath.semantics: ZFC equivalence-class quotient `A /. R = { [x]_R | x e. A }` where `R` is an equivalence relation (`R EqvRel A`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `(A /. R)` to `Quotient s` and `[x]_R = [y]_R <-> x R y` (`qseleq`) to `Quotient.eq`.
pitfalls: Metamath `[x]_R` is a set of elements `⊆ A`, whereas Lean `Quotient s` is an abstract type

translation_rules.notes: Isabelle quotient_type maps to Lean 4 Quotient with explicit Setoid.

translation_rules.target_construct: theorem f_resp (h : a ~ b) : f a ~ f b
translation_rules.notes: Coq Proper morphism instance translates to Lean 4 resp theorem for Quotient.lift.

translation_rules.source_construct: Setoid A + Func f cong (or Cubical A / R)
translation_rules.notes: Replaces explicit Setoid morphism packaging with Lean kernel Quotient.lift.
Maps ZFC partition quotients to Lean Quotient.

mechanisms.description: Discrimination between distinct inductive constructors and extraction of equality certificates from injected constructor arguments.

lean4.syntax_pattern: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction
lean4.semantics: Constructor disjointness and injectivity are derived kernel theorems for every inductive type.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use cases h which automatically discharges impossible constructor combinations and injects arguments into the context.
pitfalls: Dependent types where indices depend on earlier constructor arguments requiring dependent elimination

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: inversion H; subst. or discriminate H.
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Discriminates impossible constructors by constructing discriminant functions into empty datatypes; unifies constructor parameters.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Combine inversion H; subst to immediately simplify equality hypotheses.
pitfalls: inversion generating massive contexts of redundant equality hypotheses requiring manual subst or clear

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: apply (cases t) or by simp (with datatype distinctness rules)
isabelle_hol.semantics: Datatype distinctness (distinct) and injectivity (inject) theorems loaded automatically into the simplifier.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Invoke simp to automatically refute contradictory constructor equations like Suc n = 0.
pitfalls: Complex nested inductive predicates not recognized as datatypes requiring explicit elimination rules

hol_light.semantics: Application of axioms generated by define_type stating constructor inequality and injectivity.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Use REWRITE_TAC with datatype axiom theorems or dedicated distinctness tactics.
pitfalls: Manual decomposition of multi-argument constructor equalities

agda.syntax_pattern: inv (step h) = h ; inv ()
agda.semantics: First-class dependent pattern matching with built-in constructor disjointness (absurd pattern `()`) and injectivity.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Match directly on the indexed family constructor; impossible branches are discharged with `()`.
pitfalls: `--without-K` restricts pattern unification when self-equality of indices would require Streicher's K axiom

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Constructor injectivity & disjointness: peano2, peano5, opth $)
metamath.semantics: Explicit Peano/Kuratowski injectivity theorems (`peano5`: `suc m = suc n -> m = n`, `opth` for ordered pairs) and explosion (`pm2.21i`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `peano5`/`opth` to `cases h` or `injection h` and `peano2` (`suc n != 0`) to `nomatch h` / `contradiction`.
pitfalls: Set-theoretic encodings of constructors in `set.mm` can have accidental junk equalities outside the intended domain

translation_rules.notes: Coq inversion; subst maps directly to Lean 4 cases.
Coq discriminate constructor disequality maps to Lean 4 contradiction.
Both Agda and Lean 4 support native dependent pattern inversion.

translation_rules.target_construct: injection h / cases h / nomatch h
translation_rules.notes: Replaces set-encoding injectivity lemmas with inductive constructor inversion.

mechanisms.description: Adjoint functor pairs between posets, complete lattices, Knaster-Tarski fixed-point theorems, and monotone operators.

lean4.syntax_pattern: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b
lean4.semantics: Algebraic typeclass hierarchy rooted in Preorder, PartialOrder, Lattice, CompleteLattice in Mathlib.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use GaloisConnection.l_le_iff to rewrite adjunctions; construct fixed points using OrderHom.lfp.
pitfalls: Typeclass diamond conflicts between different lattice paths (e.g. distributed vs complete lattices)

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: l a <= b = (a <= u b)
coq_mathcomp.semantics: MathComp order hierarchy formalized via boolean comparison predicates (<=%O).
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Leverage boolean reflection on order relations to discharge order inequalities computationally.
pitfalls: Classical vs constructive differences when handling infinite meets/joins

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: galois_connection l u
isabelle_hol.semantics: Axiomatic type classes order, lattice, complete_lattice with Knaster-Tarski fixed-point operators lfp and gfp.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Use lfp_induct for structural fixpoint induction over inductive relations.
pitfalls: Monotonicity proof obligations must precede any fixpoint unfolding

hol_light.semantics: Explicit relational and functional definitions over subset lattices or complete partial orders.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Instantiate general Knaster-Tarski theorems manually for monotonic set operators.
pitfalls: No typeclass engine to automatically infer lattice operations across numeric and set domains

agda.syntax_pattern: record GaloisConnection (P Q : Poset c l1 l2) : Set ...
agda.semantics: Order-theoretic records in `Relation.Binary.Lattice` and `Relation.Binary.Structures`.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Map Agda `GaloisConnection` records to Mathlib `GaloisConnection l u`.
pitfalls: Agda parameterizes posets by both underlying equality `≈` and order `≤` (`Poset c l1 l2`), whereas Lean 4 uses `PartialOrder α` on `=`

metamath.syntax_pattern: P e. Poset , L e. Lat , L e. CLat
metamath.semantics: Extensible lattice structures (`Lat`, `CLat`) with join/meet slots and order closures.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `L e. CLat` to `[CompleteLattice α]` and adjoined monotone maps to `GaloisConnection l u`.
pitfalls: Metamath `sup`/`inf` slots require explicit closure and non-emptiness proofs unless `L e. CLat` is established

translation_rules.notes: Direct mathematical equivalence between Isabelle and Mathlib Galois connections.
Maps Setoid-parameterized Agda Poset Galois connection to Mathlib GaloisConnection.
Maps extensible CLat structure to Mathlib CompleteLattice and GaloisConnection.

mechanisms.description: Construction of dependent pairs packaging data with propositional certificates, and existential witness extraction.

lean4.syntax_pattern: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>
lean4.semantics: Inductive structure Subtype with fields val and property living in Type.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use anonymous constructor syntax <x, h> for construction and s.val or s.1 for extraction.
pitfalls: Propositional equality on subtypes requires Subtype.ext (proof irrelevance on the certificate)
Coercion confusion between the subtype and underlying carrier

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: { x : A | P x } or { x : A & P x }
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Constructive dependent pair datatypes in Type/Set with distinct projection accessors.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Use exist (fun x => P x) v h or destructure with let '(exist x h) := s in ...
pitfalls: Proof irrelevance does NOT hold by default in Coq without importing ProofIrrelevance axiom, making subtype equality proofs harder

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: typedef 'a my_subtype = "{x::'a. P x}"

lean4.syntax_pattern: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Scope classical reasoning with open scoped Classical; mark noncomputable functions with noncomputable def.

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: classic: P \/ ~P

coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: MathComp avoids classical axioms by relying on boolean reflection over finite/decidable domains.
pitfalls: Importing classical axioms pollutes constructive extraction to OCaml/Haskell

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: SOME x. P x
isabelle_hol.semantics: Higher-Order Logic is classical by default; Hilbert's epsilon operator Eps is built into the core logic.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Use SOME x. P x whenever an existential witness must be named; use by blast or by (rule ccontr) for classical refutation.
pitfalls: Functions defined via SOME cannot be executed by the code generator without explicit executable alternative equations

hol_light.semantics: Classical HOL with Hilbert's choice operator as primitive; SELECT_AX : |- P x ==> P (@x. P x).
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Discharge existential obligations by choosing canonical witnesses with @x. P x.
pitfalls: Lack of constructive extraction

agda.syntax_pattern: postulate em : ∀ {P : Set} → Dec P

pitfalls: Never translate an Agda `postulate` into a Lean `axiom`; use Lean's built-in `Classical.choice` (`noncomputable` + `Classical.choose`)

Loss of monotonicity in composite state spaces

coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Couple state invariants with inductive trace relations.

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: inductive_set invariant where ... and lemma step_preserves: "s : invariant ==> step s : invariant"
isabelle_hol.semantics: Inductive set definitions with automatic monotonic fixed-point calculations; probabilistic program verification packages.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Use induct on transition systems with auto-generated case rules.
pitfalls: Measure theory obligations when extending to continuous or uncountably infinite state spaces

hol_light.semantics: System transitions defined by relational clauses; invariant induction over transitive closures.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Prove base step and inductive step via INV_INDUCT.
pitfalls: Manual reconstruction of state space equivalence lemmas

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Discrete trajectory & energy bounds: rtrcl, uzind, sqge0 $)
metamath.semantics: Reflexive-transitive closure (`rtrcl`) and integer-indexed recurrence inequalities via `uzind` and `sqge0`.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `uzind` recurrence energy bounds into inductive Lyapunov certificates discharged by `omega`, `linarith`, or `nlinarith`.

mechanisms.description: Decision procedures and certificate generators for Presburger arithmetic, linear/nonlinear real and rational inequalities, polynomial ring identities, and positivity.

lean4.syntax_pattern: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity
lean4.semantics: Kernel-checked proof-term generation for integer Presburger (`omega`), Fourier-Motzkin linear arithmetic (`linarith`), commutative rings (`ring`), and sign analysis (`positivity`).
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use `omega` for `Nat`/`Int` linear goals, `ring` for polynomial identities, `positivity` for `0 <= x` / `0 < x`, and `linarith`/`nlinarith` for `Rat`/`Real` inequalities.
pitfalls: Silent `Nat.sub` truncation `a - b = 0` when `a < b`; provide `h : b <= a` before `omega` or `zify`
`ring` does not use local inequality or non-equational hypotheses; pass them to `linarith` instead

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: by lia | by lra | by ring
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Micromega certificate checkers (`lia`, `nia`, `lra`, `nra`) and reflective polynomial normalizer (`ring`).
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `lia` -> `omega`, `lra` -> `linarith`, `nia`/`nra` -> `nlinarith`, and `ring` -> `ring`.
pitfalls: MathComp `ssrnat` operations (`.+1`, `addn`, `subn`) require `zify` or `nat_norm` before `lia` works cleanly

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: by linarith | by presburger | by algebra | by sos
isabelle_hol.semantics: Cooper's algorithm (`presburger`), Simplex/Fourier-Motzkin (`linarith`), Groebner bases (`algebra`), and sum-of-squares (`sos`).
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Map `by presburger` -> `by omega`, `by linarith` -> `by linarith`, and `by algebra` -> `by ring`.
pitfalls: `sos` relies on external CSDP certificates unless reconstructed; use `nlinarith` or `polyrith` in Lean 4

hol_light.semantics: LCF-verified linear/ring decision procedures (`ARITH_TAC` on `num`, `INT_ARITH_TAC` on `int`, `REAL_ARITH_TAC` and `REAL_RING` on `real`).
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `ARITH_TAC` / `INT_ARITH_TAC` -> `omega`, `REAL_ARITH_TAC` -> `linarith`, and `REAL_RING` -> `ring`.
pitfalls: `REAL_RING` handles non-zero denominator clearing internally; in Lean 4 run `field_simp` before `ring`

agda.syntax_pattern: solve 3 (\ a b c -> lhs := rhs) refl x y z
agda.semantics: Reflective semiring/ring equality solvers in `Data.Nat.Solver` and explicit monotonicity combinators for inequalities.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Collapse Agda `+-*-Solver` calls to `ring` and multi-line `+-mono-≤` trees to `omega` or `linarith`.
pitfalls: Agda lacks built-in `linarith` or `positivity`; inequality trees in Agda shrink by 90% when ported to Lean 4

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Ordered field & ring axioms: leadd1i, sqge0, addass, distr $)
metamath.semantics: First-principles ring and ordered-field theorems in `set.mm`.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Replace 20-line `set.mm` algebraic/inequality subproofs with a single `ring`, `linarith`, `omega`, or `positivity` call.
pitfalls: `set.mm` `N` is a subset of `C` so `a - b` is never truncated; guard `Nat.sub` when porting to Lean 4 `Nat`

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.description: Management of algebraic embeddings across numeric towers (Nat -> Int -> Rat -> Real -> Complex) and clearing non-zero denominators in fields.

lean4.syntax_pattern: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring
lean4.semantics: Bidirectional `@[norm_cast]` attribute classification (`squash`, `move`, `elim`) normalizing ↑ coercions, paired with `zify` (`Nat -> Int` lift) and `field_simp`.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use `zify [h]` to lift `Nat.sub` to `Int` before `omega`, `push_cast; ring` for mixed-cast equalities, and `field_simp; ring` for rational expressions.
pitfalls: `Nat.cast_sub` requires `b <= a`; without it `push_cast` cannot push `↑(a - b)` inward
`field_simp` leaves denominator non-zero goals if `positivity` or local hypotheses cannot discharge them automatically

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: rewrite !PoszD !mulrz | rewrite divfK //
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Explicit ring morphism rewrites (`intrD`, `natrD`, `PoszD` in `ssrint`/`ssrnum`) and explicit non-zero cancellation (`divfK`, `mulfVK`).
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Replace `rewrite !intrD !intrM` with `push_cast` / `norm_cast`, and `rewrite divfK //` with `field_simp`.
pitfalls: MathComp's `Posz` (`n%:Z`) and `_%:R` are explicit functions rather than unified `@[norm_cast]` attributes

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: by (simp add: field_simps of_nat_add)
isabelle_hol.semantics: Simp-set collections (`field_simps`, `divide_simps`) that cross-multiply denominators under `if d = 0` splits, plus `of_nat_*` homomorphisms.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `simp add: field_simps` to `field_simp; ring` and `of_nat_*` simp chains to `norm_cast` / `push_cast`.
pitfalls: Isabelle's `field_simps` splits on `d = 0 \/ d != 0` automatically, whereas Lean's `field_simp` looks for `d != 0` in context

hol_light.semantics: Rewrite suites pushing `&n` (`real_of_num`) outward/inward and `REAL_FIELD` reducing field goals to Positivstellensatz/ring obligations.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Map `REWRITE_TAC[REAL_OF_NUM_CLAUSES]` to `norm_cast` and `CONV_TAC REAL_FIELD` to `field_simp; ring`.
pitfalls: `REAL_OF_NUM_SUB` requires `m <= n` as an explicit antecedent just like `Nat.cast_sub`

agda.syntax_pattern: rewrite +-pos m n | *-cancelʳ-≡ _ _ hnz
agda.semantics: Explicit constructor homomorphisms (`+-pos : (+ m) + (+ n) ≡ + (m + n)`) without implicit coercion search.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Replace explicit `+-pos` / `*-pos` rewrites with `push_cast` or `norm_cast` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Agda terms contain explicit embedding constructors that disappear into `↑` coercions in Lean 4

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Subset tower N c_ Z c_ Q c_ R c_ C: nnz, zcn, adddiv, divcan2 $)
metamath.semantics: Untyped ZFC subset inclusions (`N c_ Z c_ R c_ C`) where all numeric operations are complex operations `+`, `-`, `x.`, `/`.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Introduce explicit types `(n : Nat)`, `(z : Int)`, `(x : Real)` when porting `set.mm`, using `push_cast`/`norm_cast` at type boundaries and `field_simp` for `adddiv`/`divcan2`.
pitfalls: CRITICAL: `set.mm` `m - n` on `m, n e. N` produces a negative integer in `Z` when `m < n`, whereas Lean `(m - n : Nat)` truncates to `0`! Always cast `(m : Int) - (n : Int)` or add `n <= m`

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.description: Definitions by well-founded recursion over custom measures/relations and proofs using automatically generated functional induction principles.

lean4.syntax_pattern: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...
lean4.semantics: `WellFounded.fix` compilation with automatic equation lemmas (`f.eq_def`) and functional induction principle (`f.induct`, invoked via `fun_induction`).
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Pair `termination_by` + `decreasing_by omega` with `fun_induction f` so proof branches mirror the function's control flow 1-to-1.
pitfalls: Unfolding a well-founded function via `dsimp` fails because it is compiled via `WellFounded.fix`; use `rw [f]` or `fun_induction f`

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: Equations f (n : nat) : nat by wf n lt := ... | funelim (f n)
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Sozeau's `Equations` package compiling well-founded definitions and generating the `funelim` elimination principle.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `Equations ... by wf` + `funelim (f x)` directly to Lean 4 `termination_by` + `fun_induction f x`.
pitfalls: Avoid legacy `Program Fixpoint` / `Function` when porting; their manual proof obligations map cleanly to `decreasing_by` + `fun_induction`

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: function f where ... by pat_completeness auto termination by (relation "measure g") auto | proof (induct rule: f.induct)
isabelle_hol.semantics: Krauss's `function` package generating `.simps` and custom computation induction `f.induct`.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Map `termination by (relation "measure g")` to `termination_by g x` and `induct rule: f.induct` to `fun_induction f`.
pitfalls: Isabelle `<*mlex*>` lexicographic measures map to tuple measures `(m1 x, m2 x)` in Lean 4 `termination_by`

hol_light.semantics: Harrison's general recursive `define` command backed by `WF_REC` and `MEASURE`.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `MATCH_MP_TAC WF_IND` to `fun_induction` or `WellFounded.induction`.
pitfalls: HOL Light does not automatically generate a custom `f.induct` theorem for `define`; Lean 4's `fun_induction` simplifies these proofs substantially

agda.syntax_pattern: go : (x : A) -> Acc _<_ x -> B
agda.semantics: Structural recursion over an explicit accessibility proof `Acc _<_ x`.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Drop the explicit `Acc _<_ x` parameter when porting to Lean 4 and write a clean `termination_by` clause.
pitfalls: Agda functions parameterized by `Acc` carry the accessibility proof in their type signature unless wrapped

metamath.semantics: Set-theoretic transfinite/well-founded recursion theorem (`frfi`) constructing a function class as a union of approximations.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Replace `frfi` approximation unions with native `termination_by` recursive definitions in Lean 4.
pitfalls: `frfi` restricts the recursive call via function restriction `( F |` Pred(R, A, x) )`

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.description: Formalization of sigma-algebras, Caratheodory outer measures, lower Lebesgue integration on ENNReal, Bochner integration on Banach spaces, and almost-everywhere (ae) filter reasoning.

lean4.syntax_pattern: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2
lean4.semantics: Mathlib `MeasureTheory.Measure` with `∫⁻` (`ENNReal` lower Lebesgue integral), `∫` (Bochner integral returning `0` if non-integrable), and `ae μ` filter.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Discharge measurability via `measurability` or `fun_prop`, combine `∀ᵐ x ∂μ` hypotheses via `filter_upwards`, and use `Integrable f μ` for Bochner linearity.
pitfalls: `∫⁻` takes values in `ℝ≥0∞` where `∞ - ∞ = 0`; use `∫` (Bochner) for signed cancellation
Bochner `integral_add` requires `Integrable f μ` and `Integrable g μ` side conditions

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: \int[mu]_(x in D) f x | {ae mu, forall x, P x}
coq_mathcomp.semantics: MathComp-Analysis `measureType` and Lebesgue integration over extended reals `\bar R` with `measurable` tactic.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `\int[mu]_(x in D) f x` to `∫ x in D, f x ∂μ` (or `∫⁻` for non-negative extended reals) and `{ae mu, ...}` to `∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ...`.
pitfalls: MathComp-Analysis integrates into `\bar R` (`[-∞, +∞]`), whereas Mathlib splits `∫⁻` (`[0, +∞]`) and `∫` (Banach space `E`)

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: LINT x:M. f x | integral⇧N M f | AE x in M. P x
isabelle_hol.semantics: Hölzl-Himmelmann `HOL-Analysis` / `HOL-Probability` non-negative integral (`integral⇧N` on `ennreal`) and Bochner integral (`LINT`).
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Mathlib's `MeasureTheory` is a direct descendant of Isabelle's `HOL-Analysis`: `integral⇧N M f` -> `∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ`, `LINT x:M. f x` -> `∫ x, f x ∂μ`, `AE x in M` -> `∀ᵐ x ∂μ`.
pitfalls: Isabelle measures carry an explicit carrier set `space M` (`x ∈ space M`), whereas Mathlib uses the full type `α` with `[MeasurableSpace α]`

hol_light.syntax_pattern: (f has_integral y) s | integral s f | negligible s
hol_light.semantics: Henstock-Kurzweil gauge integral on `real^N` (`has_integral`) and Lebesgue measurable sets (`measurable`).
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `(f has_integral y) s` on absolutely integrable functions to `HasIntegral f s y` / `IntegrableOn f s volume ∧ ∫ x in s, f x = y`.
pitfalls: Henstock-Kurzweil integrates conditionally convergent oscillations (e.g. `sin x / x` on `[0, ∞)`) that are not Lebesgue/Bochner `Integrable` without improper limit wrappers

agda.syntax_pattern: record Measure (X : Set) : Set₁
agda.semantics: Constructive or postulated sigma-algebra records in specialized Agda libraries.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Lift Agda sigma-algebra definitions into Mathlib `[MeasurableSpace α]` and `(μ : Measure α)`.
pitfalls: Agda has no standard Bochner integration library; port abstract measure axioms to Mathlib `MeasureTheory`

metamath.syntax_pattern: ( S _|_ F ) , F e. Mbf , F e. Itg
metamath.semantics: Lebesgue measure (`vol`) and integral (`itg1`, `itg2`, `Mbf`, `Itg`) on `R` plus general outer measure spaces (`oms`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `F e. Mbf` -> `Measurable f` (`by measurability`), `F e. Itg` -> `Integrable f volume`, and `(S _|_ F)` -> `∫ x in S, f x`.
pitfalls: Default `set.mm` `itg` is 1D Lebesgue integration over `R`; multidimensional integrals use product measures

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.description: Indexed finite sums, products, and commutative monoid folds over finite sets, ranges, and filtered predicates, including reindexing bijections and sum swapping.

lean4.syntax_pattern: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x
lean4.semantics: `Finset.sum` and `Finset.prod` commutative-monoid fold over deduplicated `Finset α` (`open BigOperators`).
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use `Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ...)` for pointwise rewrites, `Finset.sum_bij` for reindexing, and `Finset.sum_comm` for swapping double sums.
pitfalls: `Finset.range n` is `[0, n)` (size `n`), whereas `Finset.Icc 1 n` is `[1, n]`; watch index bounds carefully
`Finset.sum_union` requires `Disjoint s t`

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: \sum_(i < n | P i) F i | \prod_(x in A) F x
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Canonical `\big[op/idx]_(i <- r | P i) F i` library supporting monoid laws, index filtering, and partition reindexing.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `eq_bigr` -> `Finset.sum_congr rfl`, `bigD1` -> `Finset.add_sum_erase`, `exchange_big` -> `Finset.sum_comm`, and `| P i` -> `∑ i ∈ s with P i, F i`.
pitfalls: MathComp's `\big` operates over a list `r` and only uses commutativity/idempotence when `r` is duplicate-free (`uniq r`)

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: (∑x∈A. f x) | (∏x∈A. f x)
isabelle_hol.semantics: `Groups_Big.sum` over `'a set` (returning `0` automatically when `infinite A`).
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `(∑x∈A. f x)` under `finite A` to `∑ x ∈ A, f x` over `A : Finset α`.
pitfalls: Isabelle `∑x∈A. f x` defaults to `0` on infinite sets; if finiteness is not obvious in Lean 4, use `finsum` (`∑ᶠ x, f x`) or carry `A : Finset α`

hol_light.syntax_pattern: sum s f | nsum (1..n) f | product s f
hol_light.semantics: `iterate (+) s f` over predicates `s : A -> bool` (`sum` for `real`, `nsum` for `num`).
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Map `nsum (0..n-1) f` -> `∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i` and `nsum (m..n) f` -> `∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m n, f i`.
pitfalls: HOL Light `(m..n)` is the closed interval `[m, n]`, not half-open

agda.syntax_pattern: sum (map f (upTo n))
agda.semantics: List or `Vec` folds over explicit enumeration lists (`upTo n`, `allFin n`).
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Convert list-based `sum (map f (allFin n))` into `∑ i : Fin n, f i` (`Fintype.sum`) in Lean 4.
pitfalls: List folds lack built-in `sum_bij` or `sum_comm` lemmas unless lifted to `Finset`

metamath.syntax_pattern: sum_ k e. ( M ... N ) A(k) , sum_ x e. S F(x)
metamath.semantics: Indexed sum `sum_ k e. A B` (`df-fsum`) over integer intervals `(M ... N)` (`df-fz`) or finite sets.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `sum_ k e. (M ... N) A(k)` to `∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc M N, A k` and `fsumshft` to `Finset.sum_Ico_add`.
pitfalls: In `set.mm`, `(M ... N)` is Over `Z` (integers), so `M` and `N` can be negative

translation_rules.source_construct: \sum_(i in A | P i) F i / exchange_big / bigD1
translation_rules.target_construct: ∑ i ∈ A with P i, F i / Finset.sum_comm / Finset.add_sum_erase
translation_rules.notes: Mathlib Finset.sum was designed around MathComp bigop idioms.

translation_rules.target_construct: ∑ x ∈ A, f x / Finset.sum_bij / Finset.sum_comm
translation_rules.notes: Convert 'a set with finite A to Finset alpha.

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.description: Fixed-width machine word and bitvector reasoning (`BitVec w`, `UInt64`), SWAR parallel bit manipulation, and SAT/LRAT bit-blasting.

lean4.syntax_pattern: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]
lean4.semantics: Kernel-verified LRAT certificate bit-blaster (`bv_decide` via CaDiCaL) and `BitVec`-to-`omega` preprocessor (`bv_omega`).
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use `bv_decide` for all fixed-width (`BitVec 8/16/32/64`) bitwise/arithmetic identities and `BitVec.ext` for parametric widths `BitVec w`.
pitfalls: `bv_decide` only applies to concrete bit-widths `w`; parametric widths `w : Nat` require `ext i` or induction
Nonlinear multiplication on wide `BitVec 64` can time out in SAT; factor or apply ring lemmas first

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: w : word 64 | by bitblast
coq_mathcomp.semantics: `coqword` / `Bedrock2` `word.ok` / MathComp `w.-tuple bool` fixed-width word libraries.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate fixed-width `word 64` bitwise lemmas to `BitVec 64` + `by bv_decide`.
pitfalls: Coq `Z.land` / `Z.lxor` operates on unbounded integers `Z` rather than modular `BitVec w`

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: x :: 64 word | by word_bitwise | by unat_arith
isabelle_hol.semantics: `HOL-Library.Word` (`'a::len word` inside seL4 / l4v) with `word_bitwise` and `unat_arith`.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Map `by word_bitwise` -> `by bv_decide`, `by unat_arith` -> `by bv_omega`, and `bit_eqI` -> `BitVec.ext`.
pitfalls: Isabelle `'a::len word` enforces `0 < LENGTH('a)` via the `len` sort, whereas Lean `BitVec 0` is valid

hol_light.semantics: Harrison's `Library/words.ml` (`s2n-bignum`) bit-blaster `WORD_BLAST` and modular arithmetic `WORD_ARITH_TAC`.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Replace `CONV_TAC WORD_BLAST` with `by bv_decide` and `WORD_ARITH_TAC` with `by bv_omega`.
pitfalls: Check `val` (unsigned) vs `ival` (signed 2's complement) projections -> `BitVec.toNat` vs `BitVec.toInt` in Lean 4

agda.syntax_pattern: Word64 | Vec Bool 64
agda.semantics: Builtin `Word64` primitives or length-indexed `Vec Bool n` operations.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Port `Word64` / `Vec Bool 64` lemmas to `BitVec 64` and discharge with `by bv_decide`.
pitfalls: Agda lacks an integrated SAT bit-blaster with LRAT proof reconstruction

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Set of binary bit positions: ( bits ` N ) $)
metamath.semantics: Set-theoretic representation `(bits ` N) = { k e. N0 | floor(N / 2^k) mod 2 = 1 }`.
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `k e. (bits ` N)` to `Nat.testBit n k = true` or `BitVec.getLsbD x k`.
pitfalls: Metamath `bits` models arbitrary-precision natural numbers rather than fixed-width two's complement words

translation_rules.notes: Direct mapping from seL4 HOL-Word tactics to Lean 4.10+ BitVec tactics.
Direct mapping from s2n-bignum word tactics to Lean 4 bv_decide.

mechanisms.description: Reduction of equality between compound objects (functions, sets, propositions, records, matrices, finsets) to pointwise or fieldwise equality via @[ext] lemmas.

lean4.syntax_pattern: ext x y | funext x | congr 1
lean4.semantics: Chainable `@[ext]` tactic applying type-directed extensionality lemmas (`funext`, `Set.ext`, `Finset.ext`, `Subtype.ext`, custom `@[ext] structure`) and bounded congruence `congr n`.
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Use `ext x` to peel function/set/finset/structure layers in one call, and `congr 1` to match identical outer function heads.
pitfalls: Unbounded `congr` can over-descend into dependent arguments (`HEq` goals); bound depth with `congr 1` or `congrArg`

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: apply/setP => x | apply/ffunP => i | congr (_ + _)
coq_mathcomp.semantics: Finitary extensionality views (`setP` on `{set T}`, `ffunP` on `{ffun I -> T}`, `eq_fun` for `=1` pointwise equality) Avoiding the global `functional_extensionality` axiom when possible.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `apply/setP => x`, `apply/ffunP => x`, and `f =1 g` into standard `ext x` in Lean 4 (where `funext` is derived from `Quot.sound` in the standard kernel trust base).
pitfalls: MathComp uses `f =1 g` (`eqfun`) instead of `f = g` to stay axiom-free in Coq; in Lean 4 `funext` is standard so `f = g` is preferred

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: by (rule ext) | by (auto intro!: set_eqI) | arg_cong
isabelle_hol.semantics: HOL primitive axiom `ext : (\<And>x. f x = g x) \<Longrightarrow> f = g` and set extensionality `set_eqI`.
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Map `rule ext`, `set_eqI`, and record `.equality` rules to a single `ext` call in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Isabelle `cong` inside `simp` requires explicit `[cong]` registration

hol_light.semantics: Derived function extensionality (`FUN_EQ_THM` from `ETA_AX`), set extensionality (`EXTENSION`), and LCF congruence (`AP_TERM_TAC`).
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `REWRITE_TAC[FUN_EQ_THM]` and `REWRITE_TAC[EXTENSION]` to `ext x` and `AP_TERM_TAC` to `congrArg`.
pitfalls: HOL Light sets ARE predicates `A -> bool`, so `EXTENSION` and `FUN_EQ_THM` are identical up to `IN` (`∈`) notation

agda.syntax_pattern: funext (\ x -> ...) | cong f eq
agda.semantics: Theorem `funext h i x = h x i` in Cubical Agda (`--cubical`) or explicit postulate/Setoid pointwise equality `_≗_` in `--without-K` Agda.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Replace Agda pointwise function equality `f ≗ g` (`∀ x → f x ≡ g x`) with standard `f = g` proved via `funext x` in Lean 4.
pitfalls: Standard `--safe --without-K` Agda cannot prove `funext`, forcing libraries to thread `_≗_` congruence proofs that are unnecessary in Lean 4

metamath.syntax_pattern: $( Class & function extensionality: eqrdv, fneqi, abbi $)
metamath.semantics: ZFC Axiom of Extensionality (`ax-ext`, `eqrdv`) and function graph extensionality (`fneqi`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `eqrdv` and `fneqi` to `ext x` and `fveq2i`/`oveq12i` to `congrArg` / `congr`.
pitfalls: Metamath functions are sets of ordered pairs, so `F = G` is literally set extensionality on pairs `<x, y>`

translation_rules.source_construct: apply/setP => x / apply/ffunP => x / f =1 g
translation_rules.notes: Lean 4 funext is derived from Quot.sound so =1 workarounds collapse to =.
Unified under Lean 4 @[ext] tactic.

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.description: Unified treatment of topological limits, sequence limits, improper integrals, and eventual properties via Bourbaki filters (`Filter.Tendsto`, `nhds`, `atTop`, `Eventually`).

lean4.syntax_pattern: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
lean4.semantics: Order-lattice `Filter α` where `Tendsto f l₁ l₂` is `Filter.map f l₁ ≤ l₂`, unifying sequence limits (`atTop`), topological neighborhoods (`𝓝 x`), punctured limits (`𝓝[≠] x`), and measure (`ae μ`).
lean4.idiomatic_pattern: Prove continuity with `fun_prop` (or `continuity`), combine eventualities `∀ᶠ` with `filter_upwards`, and compose limits via `Tendsto.comp` instead of unfolding `(ε, δ)`.
pitfalls: Avoid unfolding `Metric.tendsto_nhds` to `(ε, δ)` unless proving a base metric primitive
Distinguish `𝓝 x` (includes `x`) from `𝓝[≠] x` (punctured neighborhood used in derivatives)

coq_mathcomp.syntax_pattern: f @ x --> y | \near x, P x | near=> n
coq_mathcomp.semantics: MathComp-Analysis filter convergence `f @ F --> G` and `near=>` tactic for discharging `\near F, P x` eventualities.
coq_mathcomp.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `f @ x --> y` to `Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y)` and `near=> n` to `filter_upwards with n hn`.
pitfalls: MathComp-Analysis overloads `x` and `nbhs x` via canonical structures; in Mathlib write `(𝓝 x)` explicitly in `Tendsto`

isabelle_hol.syntax_pattern: (f ⤏ l) (at x within s) | (u ⇢ l) | ∀⇩F n in sequentially. P n
isabelle_hol.semantics: Hölzl-Immler-Huffman filter hierarchy (`(f ⤏ l) F`, `nhds x`, `at x within s`, `sequentially` / `at_top`).
isabelle_hol.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `(u ⇢ l)` -> `Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)`, `(f ⤏ l) (nhds x)` -> `Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 l)`, and `eventually_mono` -> `filter_upwards`.
pitfalls: CRITICAL SEMANTIC DELTA: Isabelle's `at x within s` is the *punctured* filter `𝓝[s \ {x}] x` (and `at x` is `𝓝[≠] x`), whereas Mathlib's `𝓝[s] x` (`nhdsWithin x s`) *includes* `x`!

hol_light.syntax_pattern: (f --> l) (at a within s) | (s ---> l) sequentially
hol_light.semantics: Directed nets (`net`) with `at a`, `at a within s`, `sequentially`, and `at_posinfinity`.
hol_light.idiomatic_pattern: Map `(s ---> l) sequentially` -> `Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 l)` and `(f --> l) (at a)` -> `Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 l)`.
pitfalls: Like Isabelle, HOL Light's `at a` is punctured (`0 < dist(x,a) < d`), corresponding to `𝓝[≠] a` (`nhdsWithin a {a}ᶜ`) in Mathlib

agda.syntax_pattern: ∀ ε → 0 < ε → Σ[ δ ∈ ℝ ] (0 < δ × ∀ x → dist x a < δ → dist (f x) l < ε)
agda.semantics: Direct `(ε, δ)` metric convergence predicates in Agda analysis libraries.
agda.idiomatic_pattern: Refactor explicit `(ε, δ)` proofs into `Filter.Tendsto` and `fun_prop` when porting to Lean 4.
pitfalls: Translating `(ε, δ)` proofs literally into Mathlib misses 95% of `Filter.Tendsto` and `fun_prop` automation

metamath.syntax_pattern: F : A -cn-> B , ( F ~> L ) , F e. ( J -cn-> K )
metamath.semantics: Topological continuity (`cn`), sequence convergence (`clim`: `F ~> L`), and general filter convergence (`flim`).
metamath.idiomatic_pattern: Translate `(F ~> L)` to `Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 L)` and `F : A -cn-> B` to `ContinuousOn f A` (`by fun_prop`).
pitfalls: `set.mm` `(F ~> L)` is a relational symbol (since limits need not be unique in non-Hausdorff spaces) and becomes a function value only under `T2`

translation_rules.target_construct: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 l) / Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] x) (𝓝 l) / Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l)
translation_rules.notes: Watch punctured (at x -> 𝓝[≠] x) vs unpunctured (nhds x -> 𝓝 x) neighborhood filters.

translation_rules.target_construct: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) / filter_upwards with n hn
translation_rules.notes: Direct filter convergence and eventuality mapping.
